facts.text: Fordham's common core curriculum requires undergraduate students to complete two courses in philosophy and two in theology.

sources.title: Undergraduate Study in Arts and Sciences Core Curriculum | Fordham
sources.quote: The common core curriculum includes: Two courses of English composition and literature. Two courses of philosophy, two of theology, and two of the natural sciences.
